create_BlockDiagonalCurvature: create a BlockDiagonalCurvature estimator for K-FAC preconditioning with configurable estimation modes
update_curvature_matrix_estimate: update the block diagonal curvature matrix estimate using stochastic Fisher or GGN estimation modes
update_cache: update cached matrix powers and eigenvalues for each curvature block in the estimator
multiply_matpower: multiply a parameter vector by a matrix power of the block diagonal curvature approximation
get_default_tag_to_block_ctor: get the default curvature block constructor for a given layer tag name like dense or conv2d
